parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the master instance.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcefully delete the master instance in ACK One. Valid values:

*   true: forcefully deletes the master instance in ACK One.
*   false: does not forcibly delete the master instance in ACK One.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RetainResources
parameters.description: The list of resources to retain.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adcp delete-hub-cluster --cluster-id cd90dd24a86fd42f895a1b77df6200000 --biz-force false --retain-resources eip-eip-bp1v18egqyuxzmeg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adcp DeleteHubCluster --region cn-hangzhou --RetainResources '["eip-eip-bp1v18egqyuxzmeg0000"]' --ClusterId cd90dd24a86fd42f895a1b77df6200000 --Force false
